artworks.title: Study of a Draped Figure
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a draped garment. The drawing features a garment that appears to be loosely fitted, with visible folds and creases that suggest a soft and voluminous fabric. The lines are drawn with a reddish-brown tone. The emphasis is on the natural flow and folds of the fabric as it gathers around the waist. The technique showcases a study of texture and form, capturing the way light interacts with the fabric's surface. There is an attention to detail in how the garment's folds are rendered, giving a sense of movement or potential motion.
